title: Made a music video for our game
author: Chocolatemangjd
selftext: I just made a music video for our game 'October is a moving day' didn't know what to make so made this music video for the racoons now I feel like I am the villain, it's not perfect but spent hours on it more then 3 hours our game is made with AI you can check out the game here [https://unrendered-dev.itch.io/october-is-a-moving-day](https://unrendered-dev.itch.io/october-is-a-moving-day) would like feedback
